title: Show HN: Live 3D satellite tracker and the declassified Pentagon UFO archive
summary: SkyLens is a web application that provides real-time 3D visualization of satellite positions orbiting Earth, combined with an archive of declassified Pentagon UFO/UAP documents for public research.
problem_solved: Makes complex space tracking data and declassified government UFO documents accessible through an interactive 3D interface
why_valuable: Combines two fascinating topics—live satellite tracking and government UFO disclosures—into an engaging, publicly accessible visualization platform that democratizes space data
